description: Call this tool for any spreadsheet or CSV file path; built-in file readers cannot parse spreadsheets and must not be used for them. Filter, group, aggregate and sort in one call; never hand sums over sheet_read rows.

aggregate.description: Aggregates per group, e.g. [{"col":"Units","fn":"sum","as":"total_units"}]. Defaults to a row count when group_by is given.

as.description: Output name for this aggregate, e.g. total_units

col.description: Column to aggregate, or "*" to count rows

group_by.description: Group rows by these columns before aggregating, e.g. ["Rep"] or ["Region","Rep"]

select.description: Column names to return; default all (with group_by, defaults to the group columns plus the aggregates)

sort.description: Sort column; may be an aggregate alias such as total_units

name: sheet_query
title: Filter, group and sort rows
